item.title: Rallying Cry – November 21, 2026
item.description: A research schooner embarks on an 18-month mission to study coral resilience, MLK’s handwritten 'I Have a Dream' draft goes on public display, and Ljubljana and Calvià are crowned Europe’s 2027 Capitals of Tourism.
